commands:
set -eu
ROOT=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
TREE=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/prod-loader-artwork-pr65-20261101
SSH_KEY=/Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519
PI=michal@192.168.0.23
TARGET=deaa562cdeaffff0b14beafa2a2bd1a128bf38fe
cd "$ROOT"
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$TARGET"
test ! -e "$TREE"
git worktree add --detach "$TREE" "$TARGET"
cd "$TREE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd frontend
npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund
VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build
test -s dist/index.html
test -n "$(grep -o '/assets/public-map-[^"]*\.js' dist/index.html | head -1)"
printf 'RELEASE_INDEX_SHA256='
shasum -a 256 dist/index.html
printf 'RELEASE_MAP_JS='
grep -o '/assets/public-map-[^"]*\.js' dist/index.html | head -1
printf 'RELEASE_CSS='
grep -o '/assets/index-[^"]*\.css' dist/index.html | head -1
du -sh dist
cd "$TREE"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo ===MAC_RELEASE_BUILD_PASS===
ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$PI" '
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 373d45dbaa7fa18ca7d37f32c75b1808f17bbcd0
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
systemctl is-active --quiet photomap.service
systemctl is-active --quiet cloudflared.service
BEFORE_PID=$(systemctl show photomap.service -p MainPID --value)
TUNNEL_PID=$(systemctl show cloudflared.service -p MainPID --value)
test "$BEFORE_PID" -gt 0
test "$TUNNEL_PID" -gt 0
curl -fsS --max-time 12 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null
awk "/^MemAvailable:/ {print \"MEM_AVAILABLE_KB=\" \$2; if (\$2 < 60000) exit 2}" /proc/meminfo
awk "/^SwapFree:/ {print \"SWAP_FREE_KB=\" \$2; if (\$2 < 95000) exit 2}" /proc/meminfo
df -Pk . | awk "NR==2 {print \"DISK_FREE_KB=\" \$4; if (\$4 < 80000) exit 2}"
BACKUP=.dev/deploy/2026-11-01-loader-artwork-pr65-deaa562
test ! -e "$BACKUP"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP"
cp -a frontend/dist "$BACKUP/dist-before"
python3 - "$BACKUP" <<"PY"
import sqlite3,sys
from pathlib import Path
src=Path("backend/data/app.db")
if not src.is_file(): raise SystemExit("PRODUCTION_DB_NOT_FOUND")
conn=sqlite3.connect(f"file:{src}?mode=ro",uri=True,timeout=30)
if conn.execute("PRAGMA quick_check").fetchone()[0]!="ok": raise SystemExit("DB_BAD")
dst=sqlite3.connect(Path(sys.argv[1])/"app-before.db",timeout=30)
conn.backup(dst,pages=64,sleep=0.15)
if dst.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]!="ok": raise SystemExit("BACKUP_BAD")
dst.close()
conn.close()
print("BACKUP_DB_BYTES="+str((Path(sys.argv[1])/"app-before.db").stat().st_size))
PY
test -s "$BACKUP/app-before.db"
test -s "$BACKUP/dist-before/index.html"
echo 373d45dbaa7fa18ca7d37f32c75b1808f17bbcd0 > "$BACKUP/source-before.sha"
echo "$BEFORE_PID" > "$BACKUP/backend-pid-before"
echo "$TUNNEL_PID" > "$BACKUP/tunnel-pid-before"
printf "PREVIOUS_INDEX_SHA="; sha256sum "$BACKUP/dist-before/index.html" | awk "{print \$1}"
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = deaa562cdeaffff0b14beafa2a2bd1a128bf38fe
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = deaa562cdeaffff0b14beafa2a2bd1a128bf38fe
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(systemctl show photomap.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$BEFORE_PID"
test "$(systemctl show cloudflared.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$TUNNEL_PID"
curl -fsS --max-time 12 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null
printf "PI_SOURCE="; git rev-parse HEAD
echo "BACKUP=$BACKUP"
echo "BACKEND_PID=$BEFORE_PID"
echo "TUNNEL_PID=$TUNNEL_PID"
echo ===PI_BACKUP_AND_SOURCE_FAST_FORWARD_PASS===
'
